name: Gunnery School of Nuln

specialRules.name: Impeccable Care
specialRules.text: Always buys black powder weapons at the reduced cost printed in the warband's starting equipment lists. +2 on rare rolls to find any black powder weapon.

specialRules.name: Properly Used
specialRules.text: When using the optional Misfire rules, if a 1 is rolled, roll a second dice: on a 5+ the misfire is ignored (the shot still misses but the weapon does not explode).

specialRules.name: Proud To A Fault!
specialRules.text: Members of this warband never use non-black powder ranged weapons (does not apply to hired swords or dramatis personae).

equipmentLists.name: Gunnery School equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Senior Gunnery Officer, Instructor, Senior Student, Underclassmen, Sons of the Guns, Pistoliers

items.name: Double Barrelled Pistol
items.note: 35 gc for a brace. Warband special weapon (Trading Post 25+D6 gc, brace 46+2D6; Rare 9, Rare 10 brace). Range 6", S4. Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Hand-to-hand, Double-barrelled. Double-barrelled: declare one or both barrels; both = one to-hit roll, roll to wound separately for each shot (Critical Hits separately); after firing both place 2 reload tokens, remove 1 at end of each of your shooting phases, cannot shoot in a phase you reload. Firing both guns of a brace with both barrels: 4 tokens, 2 per pistol, remove one per pistol each turn.

items.name: Double Barrelled Duelling Pistol
items.note: Printed 'D. B. Duelling Pistol'. 65 gc for a brace. Warband special weapon (Trading Post 45+2D6 gc, brace 80+4D6; Rare 11, Rare 12 brace). Range 9", S4. Accuracy, Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Hand-to-hand, Double-barrelled (see Double Barrelled Pistol).

items.name: Double Barrelled Handgun
items.note: Warband special weapon (Trading Post 60+2D6 gc; Rare 10). Range 24", S4. Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Move or Fire, Double-barrelled (see Double Barrelled Pistol).

equipmentLists.name: Marksmen equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Marksmen (Instructor may also choose from this list)

items.name: Double Barrelled Pistol
items.note: 35 gc for a brace. Warband special weapon (Trading Post 25+D6 gc, brace 46+2D6; Rare 9, Rare 10 brace). Range 6", S4. Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Hand-to-hand, Double-barrelled. Double-barrelled: declare one or both barrels; both = one to-hit roll, roll to wound separately for each shot (Critical Hits separately); after firing both place 2 reload tokens, remove 1 at end of each of your shooting phases, cannot shoot in a phase you reload. Firing both guns of a brace with both barrels: 4 tokens, 2 per pistol, remove one per pistol each turn.

items.name: Repeater Pistol
items.note: Warband special weapon (Trading Post 30+2D6 gc; Rare 9). Range 6", S4. Save Modifier, Fire Thrice, Experimental, Quick Reload, Not a Club. Fire Thrice: up to 3 shots, -1 to hit if more than one, later shots may target a model within 3" of the previous target. Experimental: always uses optional Blackpowder misfire rules; any result other than BOOM! means jammed/must reload. Quick Reload: can always fire one shot; after firing multiple shots must spend a full shooting phase not shooting and not in combat before firing multiple shots again. Not a Club: counts as a pistol in the first round of combat only; afterwards gives no additional hand weapon.

items.name: Double Barrelled Handgun
items.note: Warband special weapon (Trading Post 60+2D6 gc; Rare 10). Range 24", S4. Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Move or Fire, Double-barrelled (see Double Barrelled Pistol).

items.name: Repeater Handgun
items.note: Warband special weapon (Trading Post 60+2D6 gc; Rare 11). Range 24", S4. Save Modifier, Move or Fire, Fire Thrice (up to 3 shots, -1 to hit if more than one, later shots within 3" of previous target), Experimental (always uses optional Blackpowder misfire rules; any result other than BOOM! = jammed/must reload). Slow Reload: to reload, the warrior must do nothing (no moving, shooting or fighting) for a complete turn.

items.name: Hand-Held Mortar
items.note: Warband special weapon (Trading Post 80+2D6 gc; Rare 12). Range 24", S4. Prepared Shot, Save Modifier, Move or Fire, Scatter (on a miss the shot lands 2D6" in a random direction), Experimental (as Repeater Handgun), Explosive Radius (target and all models within 1.5" of the final landing point take a single S4 hit).

items.name: Pigeon Bombs
items.note: Hersten-Wenkler Pigeon Bombs. Warband special weapon (Trading Post 30+2D6 gc; Rare 8). Range unlimited, S4. Move or Fire, Explosive Radius (as Hand-Held Mortar), Tempermental: do not use BS; roll a D12: 9-12 hits target, 3-8 pigeon explodes harmlessly, 1-2 explodes in the bearer's hands (bearer and all within 1.5" take a S4 hit). Pigeon Roost: one purchase lasts the whole game and is replenished each game.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any models in the warband within 12" may use his Leadership for Leadership tests.

fighters.name: Instructor

specialRules.name: Expert Weaponsmith
specialRules.text: While the warband includes an Instructor, all pistol weapons get +3" range and all other black powder weapons get +6" range.

fighters.notes: Chooses from both the Gunnery School equipment list and the Marksmen equipment list.

specialRules.name: Quick Reload
specialRules.text: Marksmen have the Hunter skill. A Marksman who becomes a Hero gains no further effect from taking Hunter.

specialRules.name: Crack Shot
specialRules.text: When using pistols in close combat, may re-roll missed to-hit rolls with the pistol in the first round of combat.

conversionNotes: Properly Used: misfire-ignore roll '3+' converted to 5+.
Pigeon Bombs Tempermental: D6 table 5-6 hit / 2-4 fizzle / 1 explodes converted to D12 9-12 / 3-8 / 1-2.
Fire Thrice '-1 to hit' modifier kept as printed; unclear whether d12heim scales flat to-hit modifiers.
Impeccable Care '+2 on rare rolls' kept as printed; unclear whether rarity roll modifiers scale in d12heim.
Instructor buys from both lists but the schema allows one equipmentList; set to 'main' with a note (marksmen list usedBy also names him).
Special weapons' list prices are used as listCost (Impeccable Care makes them always available at that price); Trading Post price and rarity kept in note.

PDF spells it 'Double Barreled Pistol' and 'Double Barrrelled Handgun'; normalised to 'Double Barrelled'. Duelling Pistol and D.B. Duelling Pistol appear only in the main list, Repeater Pistol, Repeater Handgun, Hand-Held Mortar and Pigeon Bombs only in the Marksmen list.
Senior Gunnery Officer 'Hunter: See Shooting Skills' interpreted as starting with the Hunter skill.
Marksmen 'Quick Reload' rule simply grants the Hunter skill; the Repeater Pistol has a different, unrelated 'Quick Reload' weapon rule.
Pigeon Roost text says 'Once a Hero buys pigeon bombs' but they are only on the Marksmen (henchman) list, plus the Instructor; availability to other heroes is unclear.
